node.title: Re: play mp3 stream (music) portably
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I admit don't know much about this topic, but so my first instinct would be to go with a tool that already does this... for example, VideoLAN provides remote control interfaces over [https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/http_intf/|HTTP], [https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/rc/|terminal], and [https://wiki.videolan.org/Documentation:Modules/telnet/|telnet], and there are even CPAN modules like [mod://VideoLan::Client] or [mod://Vlc::Engine], the latter apparently even being an XS binding to the C API.
